title: Crop disease detection: training, evaluation code and evidence package for "Offline On-Device Two-Stage Crop Disease Detection for Smartphone Deployment in Ghana"
description: Training and evaluation code for the two-stage (EfficientNet-B2 crop/OOD gate + YOLO26 / RT-DETR / Faster R-CNN detector) crop-disease system, with the evidence package behind every number in the paper: held-out COCO metrics, bootstrap intervals, leakage-sensitivity and operating-point analyses, Faster R-CNN training records, and physical-device benchmark exports. Images: RAIL Crop Disease (Ghana) dataset, CC BY 4.0, https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/responsibleailab/crop-disease-ghana.
